findings.text: non-blocking: the gate receipt is written as raw plain text inside an .html file with no <pre> or other markup, so the served page collapses the receipt's newlines into one paragraph and the bare EXIT=0 line the fragment cites is not presented as a line a reader can follow.

non-blocking: the receipt's header names revision, tree, command, module and cwd but no host or SLURM partition, so the done_when clause "the gate runs on all_debug" is asserted only by the manifest and cannot be opened from the artifact.

non-blocking: the `already-queued` branch calls runs.read_pointer without handling CrewError, so a request promoted between the batch call and this read makes the whole command exit through an exception after its requests were already stored, instead of reporting the row.

non-blocking: mutating results[0]'s session to another-session and then resolving the plan's coordinator from the same live pointers means that when s1 is the plan's newest dispatch the whole call is skipped by the plan-owner gate, so the assertions at :127-130 can pass without the per-section another-session skip they are named for ever running.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against c8848a4e — 74fd70f0e7 adds `queue_plan` and the CLI branch plus a 226-line test, 882a7764 fixes `already-queued` rows to name the pointer's session, 98da3bf8 records the two evidence fragments; 416 insertions and 11 deletions across five files, all product, test or evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's five clauses are each asserted in tests/test_a_plan_dispatch_queues_every_section.py (counts and waits at :75-83, done/deferred reasons at :78-79, second-call skip and run-id preservation at :91-95, refused row at :110-114, another session's run named at :129-130) and the negative control (five-section call against base) is recorded red at negative-control-fixture.log with EXIT=1 against the same test at head green in focused-gate.log 15 passed; the receipt does not carry the host or partition, so the "gate runs on all_debug" clause rests on the manifest alone.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "one dispatch call queues every implementable section of a plan with its waits"; reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1616 routes a `--plan` call with no `--section` to `_queue_dispatch_batch`, which at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:719 enumerates `derive_section_todos` and hands eligible entries to `queue_batch`, and the recorded gate prints queued=3 awaiting-upstream=2 for a five-section plan whose two sections wait on a third.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records status complete, three commits, the focused gate command and its 15-passed figure, a baseline/after suite pair (55 and after 55, zero failures each), the negative-control log path and a per-failure attribution, and states that only coordinator review and merged-head verification remain.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares docs/evidence/fragments/building-a-plan-queues-all-of-it/bpq-one-call-queues-a-plan.html and the figure directory, and its scope_note records the coordinator widening grants on resume to reckon/, tests/, docs/evidence/fragments/<plan>/ and skills/reckon-build/; every path in the diff lies inside the widened set and none outside it.

justifications.durability: the added test reddens against base for the whole-plan call (negative-control-fixture.log EXIT=1) and tests/test_a_plan_dispatch_queues_every_section.py:75-95 pins the counts, the wait rows and the second-call deduplication, though the another-session row at :127-130 can also be satisfied by the plan-owner gate.
justifications.evidence: focused-gate.log records the gate at its revision with a bare EXIT=0 and negative-control-fixture.log records the same test failing at base with EXIT=1, but no line in either log names the host or partition the done_when requires.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:719 follows the module's lazy-import and docstring idiom and introduces no plan, phase or ticket label in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:719 builds one batch entry per implementable section with its waits and the CLI path at reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1616 reaches it from a section-less `--plan` call.
justifications.reuse: `queue_plan` delegates enumeration to `_plan_html.derive_section_todos`, ownership to `resolve_plan_coordinators`, entry contract and waits to `queue_batch` and mount resolution to `project_mount_repository`; a capability search over reckon/ for a whole-plan queue found no earlier owner to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five changed paths are all inside the grants the manifest's scope_note records the coordinator widening, and no hunk reaches a plan file or shared index.
